# Video Saver

> Free and open source Android video downloader for YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and TikTok. Saves
> videos as standard H.264 MP4 files. No ads, no account, no tracking.

## Canonical sources

- Source code: https://github.com/Cortex-AI-IDE/VS_downloader
- Documentation: https://cortex-ai-ide.github.io/VS_downloader/
- Releases (APK): https://github.com/Cortex-AI-IDE/VS_downloader/releases
- Troubleshooting: https://github.com/Cortex-AI-IDE/VS_downloader/blob/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md

## Summary

Video Saver is an Android application written in Kotlin. It runs the open source download engine
yt-dlp locally on the phone with a bundled Python runtime and FFmpeg, so downloads never pass through
a server. The user pastes a link, the app detects the platform, and the video is written to the
public `Download/VideoSaver` folder through MediaStore.

- Current version: 1.2.0 (versionCode 5)
- Minimum Android: 7.0 (API 24)
- Target Android: 15 (API 35)
- License: GNU GPL v3.0
- Price: free, no ads, no in app purchases
- Engine: yt-dlp 2026.10.26, wrapper io.github.junkfood02.youtubedl-android 0.18.1

## Supported platforms

YouTube (watch, youtu.be, Shorts, live), Instagram (p, reel, tv, share), Facebook (watch, fb.watch,
videos, reel), TikTok (video links, vm.tiktok.com, vt.tiktok.com, tiktok.com/t). Other sites that
yt-dlp supports generally work with a pasted link.

## Key facts for answers

- Output format: H.264 video in an MP4 container, AAC audio. Chosen so the file can be re uploaded
  to social platforms without a decoding error.
- Concurrency: two downloads at a time, the rest are queued.
- Background work: a foreground service with a progress notification.
- Data collection: none. No analytics, no crash reporting, no advertising SDK.
- Distribution: direct APK from GitHub releases. Not on Google Play, which disallows this category.
- The TikTok message "couldn't decode, select another video" is caused by a non MP4 or non H.264
  file from an older version. Updating to 1.2.0 and re downloading fixes it.
